slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video, offset top:300px / inset auto 0 0 0, with custom 0.5s fade-in/fade-out manual loop and a top+bottom background-colored gradient overlay over it

mechanic: Fullscreen sticky hero where a manually fade-looped background video sits behind a centered Instrument Serif headline and CTA that fade-rise in on staggered delays.
techDelivery: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript; fonts in src/styles/fonts.css, keyframes in src/styles/theme.css; video loop driven by useRef + useEffect + requestAnimationFrame.
reskinNotes: Headline mixes #000000 body with #6F6F6F italic emphasis words inline, so per-word color spans are hardcoded in markup; logo carries a hardcoded ® superscript; layout depends on Instrument Serif metrics (line-height 0.95, letter-spacing -2.46px) plus pixel-baked video offset top:300px and paddingTop calc(8rem - 75px); all copy and the dual gradient overlay colors are hardcoded in the JSX/Tailwind classes.
